title: Titanium Valve Strainer Basket
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5, UNS R56400) was selected for this valve component application because its 900+ MPa tensile enables thin-wall lightweighting under cyclic loading. The alpha-beta microstructure provides 45% higher specific strength than 4140 steel, critical for weight-sensitive designs. Its 6.7 W/mK thermal conductivity simplifies thermal management. This rationale is driven by perforated valve strainer basket and service environment demands.
process: Closed-die forging net shape for valve component geometry
surfaceTreatment: Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction
commonFailures: H2 permeation at >100 bar pressure - reduced by ALD alumina barrier 0.5um on gas-wetted surfaces

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Valve Strainer Basket suitable for Perforated valve strainer basket?
faq.a: Titanium Valve Strainer Basket uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address valve component operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Valve Strainer Basket?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Valve Strainer Basket require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. valve component components receive Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Valve Strainer Basket shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Strainer / Filter basket valve component components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
